title: Defra UNVTD canonical core
description: Canonical component schema for Defra internal models using UN/CEFACT/UNVTD building blocks. Property names and value kinds follow the UN/CEFACT D23B JSON-LD vocabulary (https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/unece-context-D23B.jsonld): xsd:string-typed terms are JSON strings; @vocab-typed terms are JSON strings; @id-typed terms are JSON objects or strings per JSON-LD. That file defines the RDF types ExchangedDocument and Consignment (PascalCase keys) and many association properties, but it does not currently declare the BSP assembly property keys exchangedDocument or specifiedConsignment (camelCase) used on the JSON root alongside UN JSON Schemas (e.g. UNECE-BSPMaster D23B). defra-unvtd-core-v1.context.jsonld adds only those two missing keys as Defra profile aliases (not unece terms), so we avoid minting unofficial vocabulary entries while preserving a stable JSON-LD expansion for TRACES-oriented payload shape. If UN later publishes exchangedDocument/specifiedConsignment in the official context, remove the Defra aliases and use the official mapping directly.

urlId.description: Codelist URI. EU TRACES: https://traces-codelists.ec.europa.eu/{listId}. Defra: https://codelists.tbc.defra.gov.uk/...

name.description: Human-readable label for the coded value.

unitCode.description: Weight unit code (subset of UN/CEFACT Rec 20/21 used by this profile).

governmentActionTypeCode.description: unece:governmentActionTypeCode is @vocab in unece-context-D23B.jsonld; use a string code or vocabulary token.

provider.description: The party authenticating this signatory entry (the issuing veterinarian, the certifying authority, the inspecting body). Maps to UN/CEFACT documentAuthentication.provider. Renamed from providerParty per TIG §4.4 naming alignment.

Clause.description: A clause attached to a signatory's authentication. Matches BSP D23B documentClauseType (UN01002646): identifier is the bare clause identifier (e.g. PURPOSE / GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS), content is the clause content (e.g. INTERNAL_MARKET / BREEDING_AND_PRODUCTION). The optional sibling urlId carries a URL to the codelist these values are drawn from (e.g. ched_consignment_clause, eu_intra_consignment_clause); the gateway translates urlId to/from TRACES schemeId / schemeAgencyId.

urlId.description: URL to the codelist this clause's identifier and content are drawn from. BSP D23B documentClauseType.urlId (UN01013211).

countryId.description: unece:countryId is @vocab in unece-context-D23B.jsonld (e.g. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 as a vocabulary-relative token).

identifier.description: Party identifier (bare string). The sibling urlId names the codelist/register the value is drawn from (e.g. operator_internal_activity_id, veterinary_office_identifier, authority_activity_id, or Defra-side schemes such as uk_transporter_authorisation).

urlId.description: URL to the codelist/register the party identifier is drawn from. The gateway translates urlId to/from TRACES schemeId / schemeAgencyId.

partyRoleCode.description: unece:partyRoleCode as a coded value. value carries the role code; the optional sibling urlId names the codelist it is drawn from.

partyTypeCode.description: Party-type code(s) as coded values. A party can carry codes from more than one TRACES list (e.g. COMMERCIAL_TRANSPORTER under operator_activity_type plus TRANSPORTER under classification_section_code); each entry's urlId names the codelist its value is drawn from.

emailURIUniversalCommunication.description: Contact email. Additive to the legacy personName-only shape — TRACES SOAP does not carry contact email/phone, but Defra import pre-notifications source these from IPAFFS and need to carry them on consignor / consignee / delivery / carrier / issuer parties.

telephoneUniversalCommunication.description: Contact telephone. Same rationale as emailURIUniversalCommunication.

IncludedNote.description: UNECE Note (https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/Note): supported properties are aligned to the Note vocabulary term set. unece:identifier, unece:name, unece:subject, unece:creationDateTime, unece:noteSubjectCode, unece:content, and unece:contentCode are xsd:string in unece-context-D23B.jsonld. content is an array of strings and contentCode is an array of CodedValue objects so a single note can carry multiple linked codes from different codelists (e.g. refusal_reason plus refusal_reason_extent on one refusal note).

type.description: JSON-LD @type for unece:Note when using unece-context-D23B.jsonld (type aliases to @type).

noteSubjectCode.description: Legacy subject-code slot - flat string only. Retained for the existing INTRA/CHED samples; new code should use subjectCode below.

subjectCode.description: Subject of the note as a coded value. urlId on the CodedValue names the codelist the code is drawn from.

content.description: unece:content profile extension for deterministic typed contracts and lossless TRACES XML round-tripping: always an array of strings.

contentCode.description: unece:contentCode profile extension for deterministic typed contracts and lossless TRACES XML round-tripping: always an array of CodedValue objects (value + optional urlId and name).

typeCode.description: Document type per UNTDID 1001 (e.g. 853 Veterinary certificate, 636 Health certificate, 916 Related document, 705 Bill of lading).

relationshipTypeCode.description: Role this referenced document plays per UNTDID 1153.

identifier.description: Reference number assigned by the issuing authority.

issueDateTime.description: Issue date of the referenced document (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD).

attachmentBinaryObject.description: Attachment for the referenced document, carried by reference: a link to the stored file (`uri`) with `filename` and `mimeCode` alongside. File content is never embedded.

filename.description: Original filename for the attachment, where the by-reference pattern carries metadata alongside the URI.

identifier.description: Location identifier as a bare string (e.g. CPH19876, GBDVR1, GBDVR). Matches the BSP D23B canonical shape where idType metadata is disabled. The sibling urlId names the register or codelist the identifier is drawn from (cph_number, bcp_reference, un_locode).

urlId.description: URL identifier for the codelist / register this location's identifier is drawn from.

postalAddress.description: Optional postal address for the location. Additive — needed for port-of-entry and inspection-point records that carry both a codelist-tagged identifier and a human-readable address.

TradeCountry.description: A country reference (origin / export / transit / re-export). The country code lives on `code.value` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 expected). `subordinateTradeCountrySubDivision` carries a single sub-division within the country: either a region (UNCL3227 functionTypeCode '106') where regulation is regionalised, such as disease zoning on live-animal imports, or the authorities attached to the country (functionTypeCode '44', '42', '41'). `code` may be absent when TRACES sends the country purely as a carrier for those authorities.

code.description: Country code; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 expected. ISO 3166-1 is well-known so urlId is usually omitted, but a sibling urlId can be added when a non-ISO scheme is in use.

TradeCountrySubDivision.description: A sub-division of a country, whose meaning is set by `functionTypeCode`. For a region (UNCL3227 '106') `identifier` carries the region code drawn from the codelist named by the optional sibling `urlId`. For a place of authentication or a customs office ('44', '42', '41') the sub-division is a positional wrapper with no identifier of its own, and `activityAuthorizedParty` carries the authorities themselves — the shape TRACES uses to attach competent authorities and border control posts to the export, transit and re-export country.

urlId.description: URL to the codelist this region identifier is drawn from.

content.description: UNCL3227 location function. '106' Region of origin, '44' Place of authentication of document (competent authority), '42' Consignment exit customs office, '41' Consignment entry customs office.

activityAuthorizedParty.description: Authorities authorised for the activity this sub-division represents. Distinguish them by `partyRoleCode`: 'RA' central competent authority, 'VG' local competent authority, 'CM' customs / border control post.

TransportEvent.description: A scheduled or actual occurrence on a transport movement (arrival at, departure from a location). Mirrors UN/CEFACT `transportEventType`. `scheduledOccurrenceDateTime` is the declared planned time; `actualOccurrenceDateTime` is populated when the event has been observed. `occurrenceLogisticsLocation` identifies the location at which the event occurs (the destination of the leg for `arrivalEvent`; the origin for `departureEvent`), allowing consumers to identify a specific leg deterministically by matching the location identifier rather than relying on positional heuristics.

LogisticsTransportMovement.description: A transport movement (a leg of the consignment's journey). identifier carries the transport identifier (vessel name, flight number, vehicle registration). modeCode carries the mode-of-transport code (see its own description). arrivalEvent[] and departureEvent[] carry the importer-declared scheduled timing for the leg's start and end.

identifier.description: Transport identifier as a bare string or integer (legacy INTRA shape where it was sometimes numeric). Matches the BSP D23B canonical shape where idType metadata is disabled. The sibling urlId names the register the identifier is drawn from (e.g. vessel_name, road_vehicle_registration, airplane_flight_number).

urlId.description: URL identifier for the codelist / register this movement's identifier is drawn from.

modeCode.description: Mode-of-transport code, held as an integer. From the UN/CEFACT TransportModeCodeList (UN/EDIFACT Recommendation 19): 1 Maritime, 2 Rail, 3 Road, 4 Air.

usedLogisticsTransportMeans.description: The conveyance used on this leg. `name` carries the means' identifying name (vessel name, vehicle registration, flight callsign). Distinct from `identifier` on the parent movement, which carries the movement's reference (journey number, waybill, booking). Both slots can be populated and may carry different values: identifier identifies the movement, usedLogisticsTransportMeans.name identifies the vehicle / vessel / aircraft.

LogisticsSeal.description: A seal affixed to transport equipment (TRACES `AffixedSPSSeal`). `identifier` carries the seal number; the sibling `urlId` names the scheme it is drawn from. Keyed `affixedLogisticsSeal` on the parent and aliased to `unece:affixedSeal` in defra-unvtd-core-v1.context.jsonld, following the same Logistics-prefixed naming as `mainCarriageLogisticsTransportMovement`.

urlId.description: URL to the scheme this seal identifier is drawn from (e.g. seal_number).

LogisticsTransportEquipment.description: Transport equipment carrying the consignment (TRACES `UtilizedSPSTransportEquipment`), typically a container. `identifier` carries the equipment number; `affixedLogisticsSeal` carries the seals applied to it. Keyed `utilizedLogisticsTransportEquipment` on the consignment and aliased to `unece:utilizedTransportEquipment` in defra-unvtd-core-v1.context.jsonld.

urlId.description: URL to the scheme this equipment identifier is drawn from (e.g. container_number).

ExaminationEvent.description: An examination (inspection) of the consignment (TRACES `ExaminationSPSEvent`, `unece:examinationEvent`). `occurrenceLogisticsLocation` is where the examination takes place.

AppliedProcess.description: A process applied to the goods on a trade line (TRACES `AppliedSPSProcess`, `unece:appliedProcess`) — for example transport organisation. `typeCode` names the process per UNCL7187, held as an open string; `operatorParty` (`unece:operatorParty`) is the party carrying it out.

urlId.description: URL to the codelist this process typeCode is drawn from.

levelCode.description: Packaging hierarchy level per the UNECE PackagingLevelCode list. For example 4, no packaging hierarchy, for a single flat set of packages.

typeCode.description: Package type per the UNECE PackageTypeCode list (UN/EDIFACT Recommendation 21), for example a cage or crate. Held as an open string. unece:typeCode is xsd:string in unece-context-D23B.jsonld.

itemQuantity.description: The number of packages of this type, the package count.

TradeProduct.description: The product (commodity) carried on a trade line. Minimal at core level — carries description, type code, classification, and an optional per-product `originCountry`.

typeCode.description: BSP/D23B canonical slot (`unece:typeCode`, `xsd:string`) for the trade product's type/form code. Drawn from the codelist named by the sibling `urlId`.

urlId.description: URL to the codelist this trade product's typeCode is drawn from.

originCountry.description: Per-product country of origin. Optional at core level; populated by profiles whose journeys carry origin per trade line rather than per consignment (TRACES CHED-PP's `OriginSPSCountry` is the round-trip target). Region of origin sits on `subordinateTradeCountrySubDivision` inside the `TradeCountry` shape and is carried with the country wherever it appears.

LineTradeDelivery.description: Delivery aspect of a trade line — what's being delivered on this line (quantities, weights at line level).

scientificName.description: The species name for the commodity in Latin

netVolume.description: Net volume of the goods on this line, with unitCode carrying the UN/ECE Rec 20 unit (e.g. H87 piece, LTR litre). Aliased to `unece:netVolumeMeasure` in defra-unvtd-core-v1.context.jsonld.

originCountry.description: Country of origin of the goods on this line (TRACES line-level `OriginSPSCountry`, `unece:originCountry`). Line-level origin, distinct from the consignment-level `originCountry`, for consignments whose lines originate in different countries.

appliedProcess.description: Processes applied to the goods on this line (TRACES `AppliedSPSProcess`, `unece:appliedProcess`).

specifiedTradeProduct.description: The trade product on this line. BSP-canonical structural slot; profile schemas may narrow shape and cardinality.

specifiedLineTradeDelivery.description: Delivery aspect of this line (line-level quantities).

additionalInformationNote.description: Per-line annotation notes. Each entry carries a coded subject and one or more content values; consumers narrow the permitted subject codes in their profile.

traderAssignedId.description: Optional trader-entered reference. BSP/D23B canonical slot (unece:traderAssignedId, xsd:string) for an importer's own internal reference number against the consignment / pre-notification.

documentTypeCode.description: Document type per UNTDID 1001 (e.g. 636 Health certificate, 666/856 INTRA). Optional at core level; profile schemas constrain by const/enum.

documentStatusCode.description: Status code as string per UN vocabulary typing for coded strings.

notificationStatusCode.description: Defra-internal workflow status of this notification. Codelist binding declared in the Defra profile vocabulary.

versionId.description: Document revision number. V1 on first submission, increments on each subsequent re-submission. Distinct from the envelope's aggregateVersion (event sequence) and the schema's structural version.

functionCode.description: UNTDID 1225 message function: 9 (Original), 5 (Replace), 4 (Change), 1 (Cancellation), 3 (Deletion). Tells the consumer what the message does to its view of the document.

issueDateTime.description: The datetime this version of the document was issued. For a pre-notification, issuance is the submission, so this carries the submission moment and is re-stamped on each re-submission: the original submission datetime on the NotificationSubmitted event, and the amendment's submission datetime on the latest NotificationSubmissionAmended event. This is the notification's own issuance datetime, distinct from the issue dates of accompanying documents held under referenceDocument.

revisionDateTime.description: UNECE Exchanged_Document.Revision.DateTime — when this document was last revised. When present on a TRACES certificate, copied from the IncludedSPSNote with SubjectCode LAST_UPDATE_DATETIME (note content). The LAST_UPDATE_DATETIME note is retained in includedNote. Distinct from issueDateTime (document issuance) and from the event envelope timestamp (when CertificateUpdated was emitted).

issuer.description: The party responsible for issuing this document. For TRACES CHED and Defra import pre-notifications, this carries the responsible-person organisation with a named contact. This is the organisation of record, not the individual who submitted the notification; the submitting user is an event-level identity, not carried in this payload.

deliveryParty.description: The immediate delivery party — the party to whom the consignment is delivered. Distinct from final destination (Defra pre-notification adds finalDestinationLocation for the permanent post-movements destination at profile level).

carrier.description: The carrier party (the transporter). Operational TRACES populates both an activity-type discriminator (operator_activity_type) and a section-code discriminator (classification_section_code) on partyTypeCode.

originCountry.description: The country the consignment originated from - where the goods were produced. For consignments where the country of production differs from the country of export, this slot carries the country of production and `exportCountry` carries the country of export; for the common case where they coincide, only `originCountry` need be populated.

exportCountry.description: The country the consignment was exported from (TRACES `ExportSPSCountry`). For consignments where the country of production differs from the country of export, this slot carries the country of export and `originCountry` carries the country of production.

reExportCountry.description: Re-export countries on the consignment route (TRACES ReExportSPSCountry[]).

transitCountry.description: Transit countries on the consignment route (TRACES TransitSPSCountry[]).

loadingBaseportLocation.description: Port of exit / loading baseport (TRACES `LoadingBaseportSPSLocation`, `unece:loadingBaseportLocation`) — where the consignment is loaded for despatch.

unloadingBaseportLocation.description: Port of entry / unloading baseport. For Defra import pre-notifications the identifier carries un_locode.

utilizedLogisticsTransportEquipment.description: Transport equipment carrying the consignment, with any seals affixed to it (TRACES `UtilizedSPSTransportEquipment`). Aliased to `unece:utilizedTransportEquipment` in defra-unvtd-core-v1.context.jsonld.

mainCarriageLogisticsTransportMovement.description: Transport movement(s) for the main carriage leg(s). An array of one entry per carriage leg, with entries distinguished by id.schemeId. The SPS profile collapses BSP's three-way pre/main/on carriage split into this slot.

transitTradeCountry.description: Transit countries between the consignment's origin and destination.
